facts.fact: Capital says Ethio Telecom's telebirr is the dominant mobile-money operator with more than 60 million subscribers, and Safaricom Ethiopia's M-Pesa has also expanded.
Capital says telebirr and M-Pesa are both connected through EthSwitch, which provides interoperability linking banks, payment-service providers and merchants.
Capital describes EthSwitch as Ethiopia's national payment switch linking banks, payment-service providers, merchants and the mobile-money platforms.
